# BreadcrumbBarItem

[C# API](../index.md) / [Fluence.Wpf.Controls](index.md)

- **Assembly:** `Fluence.Wpf`
- **Namespace:** `Fluence.Wpf.Controls`

```csharp
public class BreadcrumbBarItem : ContentControl
```

The visual crumb generated by [BreadcrumbBar](BreadcrumbBar.md) for each item: a subtle button-like content host followed by a chevron separator that the default template hides on the last (current) crumb. Crumbs are keyboard focusable and activate through a mouse left-button release, Enter, or Space, raising [Click](BreadcrumbBarItem.md#api-09d30b9d9bd2).

**Base type:** [`ContentControl`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.windows.controls.contentcontrol) (including inherited WPF and .NET members)

[C# source](https://github.com/sintaxasn/Fluence.Wpf/blob/main/Fluence.Wpf/Controls/BreadcrumbBarItem.cs)

## Properties

<a id="api-e2bf0c5b735e"></a>

### IsLastItem

```csharp
public bool IsLastItem { get; }
```

Gets whether this crumb is the last (current) item of its owning [BreadcrumbBar](BreadcrumbBar.md). The default template hides the chevron separator and switches to primary SemiBold typography while this is `true`.

<a id="api-91d496c751e8"></a>

### IsPressed

```csharp
public bool IsPressed { get; }
```

Gets whether the crumb is currently pressed.

## Events

<a id="api-09d30b9d9bd2"></a>

### Click

```csharp
public event RoutedEventHandler Click
```

Occurs when the crumb is activated by a mouse left-button release that began with a press inside the crumb bounds, or by the Enter or Space key while focused. The owning [BreadcrumbBar](BreadcrumbBar.md) aggregates this into [ItemClicked](BreadcrumbBar.md#api-8c3b462d4081).
